+def statement_csv(st: ledger.Statement) -> str:
+    """The statement lines as CSV: a header row, then one row per line, each ending in CR LF."""
+    out = io.StringIO()
+    writer = csv.writer(out, lineterminator="\r\n")
+    writer.writerow(["date", "description", "amount_minor", "currency"])
+    for line in st.lines:
+        writer.writerow(
+            [line.posted_at[:10], line.description, line.amount_minor, st.account.currency]
+        )
+    return out.getvalue()
